mustFix.why: Two distinct false propositions stand. (1) The disposition misidentifies the finding. CLAUDE-G30FX-V3-S1, in the frozen review the subject itself pins at basedOn.predecessorV3.reviews.claude.sha256 65fb831f86865eab6b905ecdfce5cac9a596a9d3019392fed1d4182b696d77d0 (recomputed equal at this HEAD), is titled 'The ORDERED-EQUAL comparison against G10 occupancy v2 #$.platforms is made against an artifact the subject pins nowhere: no path, no sha256, no basedOn entry, no recordedInputs entry.' Its site is 'authorityClaim; basedOn; recordedInputs; remeasurementClause'. Nothing in S1 concerns which leftover-join is current; that is CLAUDE-G30FX-V3-M5, which the subject separately and correctly dispositions at findingDisposition.claudeV3M5 ('leftoverJoinV4.role is historical after D-321'). The claudeV3S1 entry therefore restates the M5 remedy under the S1 label and discharges nothing. (2) The S1 defect is live and unrepaired. Measured against the subject bytes: the string 'G10' occurs exactly once in the whole file, inside authorityClaim; basedOn has twenty-two members and no G10 member; recordedInputs has sixty-two keys and no key containing 'G10'; pinnedHostContext has five pointers and no G10 pointer. That is the identical state the finding was raised against at v3. Neither repair offered by S1 was taken: the comparand is not pinned, and the ORDERED-EQUAL-to-G10 clause is not dropped.
mustFix.claimTruthStatus: The ORDERED-EQUAL assertion is itself TRUE at this HEAD and is not the defect. docs/coop/artifacts/harness.DR-G10.provider-conformance.ts-major-1.v2.json #$.platforms recomputes to ["macos/arm64", "macos/x86_64", "linux/x86_64", "linux/arm64"], ordered-equal to the subject's platformsQuotedFromOccupancyV2, and that artifact's sha256 is b0cbce06487b96bbe7f6af1dae62ba3b3ca55aaa41305cb96f531099e86bf7c9. The defect is that a load-bearing cross-gate comparand is asserted without custody, so no future reader can detect the comparand moving.
mustFix.whyMustFixNotShouldFix: The underlying S1 gap is a SHOULD-FIX and was raised as one. What raises this to MUST-FIX is the disposition claim. A DESIGN-CONTRACT-CANDIDATE whose findingDisposition asserts a named finding discharged, when the finding is neither discharged nor correctly described, misreports its own review lineage to the recording authority. A D-000 recording that consults findingDisposition would conclude the v3 Stage A Claude findings were fully landed. Nine were named; eight landed; the ninth is reported landed under a description belonging to a different finding.
